runnable_code.detail: Against strands-agents 1.63.0 every request shape matches: Agent(hooks, interventions, plugins, retry_strategy, conversation_manager, structured_output_model, callback_handler); __call__(limits, cancel_signal, idempotency_token, structured_output_model); add_middleware(stage, handler); SlidingWindowConversationManager(window_size, pin_first, per_turn, proactive_compression); SummarizingConversationManager(pin_first, proactive_compression); HumanInTheLoop(allowed_tools, classifier); Confirm(prompt, response). The hooks, retry, conversation, structured output, cancellation and lifecycle blocks run as pasted, given the earlier tool definitions. The middleware, intervention, HumanInTheLoop and Agent Control blocks raise NameError as pasted, because their imports are replaced by comments that say the paths are unknown, while the docs give them. HumanInTheLoop is pointed at the wrong module (strands.vended_interventions, not strands.interventions). OpenAIModel needs the openai extra, which the install line leaves out (the post says so at L667).
